Claude models through the Messages API.

## API key

1. Sign in to the [Claude Console](https://platform.claude.com).
2. Add a card and buy credits under **Settings → Billing**.
3. Open [Settings → API keys](https://platform.claude.com/settings/keys) and create a key in the workspace you want the Gateway's calls billed to.
4. Copy the key. It's shown once.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add anthropic
```

To make it the model provider apps get by default:

```bash
everyapp ai default anthropic
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
providers: ["anthropic"],
```

The app calls `/api/ai/anthropic/…` with `createGatewayFetch()`. More in [AI](/docs/agent/ai).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp ai list` shows `anthropic` with its key set.

**Rate limits:** Requests and tokens per minute by usage tier, on the Console's Rate limits page; token counting is free, with its own per-minute limit.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Anthropic).
